observation: A dataset/source name can imply the wrong semantic role. stackv2_edu_filtered sounded educational but its actual dataset card describes openly licensed code, so placing it in educational Q&A would have distorted the intended corpus mixture.
lesson: Classify training sources by inspected content semantics and row schema, not by repository naming. Resolve exact revisions and probe representative rows before activation.
action: Moved Stack V2 Edu into software/code; added LibreTexts, PressBooks, and OERCommons to the instructional/explanatory slice; added a non-authorizing exact-revision schema probe.

observation: One-to-one InfoNCE makes every other rationale in a batch a negative, even when multiple independently written examples instantiate the same reusable principle.
lesson: For principle teaching, same-principle examples should be allowed to reinforce one another as multiple positives; otherwise contrastive learning can push semantically equivalent principles apart.
action: Added principle_tag propagation and multi-positive symmetric contrastive loss while retaining one-to-one InfoNCE only as an ablation/backward-compatible path.
